subject: Sages
text: The Sages explain that the four Fiends seized the power of the Orbs to destroy the world.

evidence.quote: They explain that the Orbs have lost their power because the Fiends of Earth, Wind, Fire, and Water have seized that power to aid them in their quest of world destruction.

subject: Circle of Sages
text: One of the Sages in Crescent Lake gives the party a Canoe to travel to the Gurgu Volcano.

evidence.quote: One of the Sages gives you a Canoe which you can use to get to the Volcano.

subject: Magic Shop
text: In Crescent Lake, White Mages should buy Inv2, while Black Mages should buy Lit3 and Rub.

evidence.quote: The magic you want is Inv2 for White Mages and Lit3 and Rub for Black Mages.

subject: Exit
text: After being promoted to Wizards, characters can return to Crescent Lake to buy Exit.

evidence.quote: When you get promoted to Wizards (later on), you should return and buy Exit because it allows you to escape any dungeon, very important indeed.

subject: Overworld River
text: To reach Gurgu Volcano by Canoe, follow the river forks: west, north, east, west, west.

evidence.quote: To reach the Gurgu Volcano, follow these directions on your Canoe.  Take the direction indicated when you come to a fork in the river:  west, north, east, west, west.

subject: Lava
text: Lava squares in Gurgu Volcano deal 1 HP of damage to each party member with every step.

evidence.quote: Throughout this volcano, there are lava squares which take 1 HP from each party member every time you step on them.

subject: 1st floor stairs
text: From the east side of the 1st floor, head straight west to reach the stairs down to the 2nd floor.

evidence.quote: You start on the east side of this floor.  Go straight west to find the stairs down to the 2nd floor.

subject: 2nd floor treasure chest
text: A treasure chest in the northern room of the 2nd floor contains a Silver Helmet.

evidence.quote: Go north until you can go west.  Get the Silver Helmet in the treasure chest.

subject: 2nd floor treasure chest
text: Heading south from the Silver Helmet chest on the 2nd floor leads to a chest containing 1520 gold.

evidence.quote: Go south to find another chest with 1520 gold.

subject: 2nd floor treasure chest
text: Taking the left path above the first chest on the 2nd floor leads to a chest with the Giant Sword.

evidence.quote: You have a choice of going left or right.  Go left to find a chest with the Giant Sword.

subject: 2nd floor treasure chest
text: Taking the right path on the 2nd floor leads to a treasure chest containing 4150 gold.

evidence.quote: Then head back and take the right path to find 4150 gold in the next chest.

subject: 2nd floor treasure chests
text: Two chests located in the northwest section of the 2nd floor contain 1545 gold.

evidence.quote: Head north as far as you can go, then go west until you spot two chests.  The path that leads down to the right of them leads to them.  They contain 1545 gold.

subject: 2nd floor southern treasure room
text: The southern room on the 2nd floor contains chests holding 2 Silver Helmets, a Silver Shield, a Silver Axe, a Cabin, 2 Heal Potions, a Pure Potion, and 6710 gold.

evidence.quote: Head south to find a room with a truckload of chests.  They contain 2 Silver Helmets, a Silver Shield, a Silver Axe, a Cabin, 2 Heal Potions, a Pure Potion and 6710 gold.

subject: 2nd floor stairs
text: Heading all the way to the west through the lava room on the 2nd floor leads to the stairs down to the 3rd floor.

evidence.quote: Then take one of the doors back to the room with the lava and go all the way to the west to find the stairs down to the 3rd floor.

subject: 3rd floor stairs
text: Heading east on the 3rd floor leads to the stairs down to the 4th floor.

evidence.quote: 3rd floor - Just head east to find the stairs down to the 4th floor.

subject: 4th floor stairs
text: Stairs in the southeast corner of the 4th floor lead to 3rd floor B.

evidence.quote: The stairs are in the southeast corner.  Try to minimize how much lava you walk on.  The stairs actually lead to a different part of the 3rd floor.

subject: 3rd floor B stairs
text: Walking south, west, south, and west on 3rd floor B leads to the stairs down to 4th floor B.

evidence.quote: You start in the northeast corner of the floor.  Walk south, west, south, and west to find the stairs down to 4th floor B.

subject: 4th floor B treasure room 1
text: The first treasure room on 4th floor B contains a Soft Potion and 2750 gold.

evidence.quote: Enter the door right next to you to find a treasure room with a Soft Potion and 2750 gold.

subject: 4th floor B treasure room 2
text: A room west and south on 4th floor B contains 1760 gold.

evidence.quote: Go west and south to find a treasure room with 1760 gold.

subject: 4th floor B treasure room 3
text: A room north and west on 4th floor B contains Flame Shield, Ice Sword, a Pure Potion, and 8220 gold.

evidence.quote: Go north and west to find a lucrative treasure room with the Flame Shield, Ice Sword, a Pure Potion, and 8220 gold.

subject: 4th floor B treasure room 4
text: A room south and east of the second treasure room on 4th floor B contains 165 gold.

evidence.quote: Go back to the second room and go south and east to find a room with 165 gold.

subject: 4th floor B treasure room 5
text: A room north and east on 4th floor B contains a House and 2000 gold.

evidence.quote: Then head north and east to find a room with a House and 2000 gold.

subject: 4th floor B treasure room 6
text: A room south and east on 4th floor B contains a Wooden Staff and 1250 gold.

evidence.quote: Go back to the previous room and head south and east to find a room with a Wooden Staff and 1250 gold.

subject: 4th floor B stairs
text: Heading south and west on 4th floor B leads to the stairs down to the 5th floor.

evidence.quote: Then head and south and west to find the stairs down to the 5th floor.

subject: Flame Armor
text: The western room on the 5th floor holds the Flame Armor, guarded by a Red Dragon.

evidence.quote: Western room:  Flame Armor (guarded by Red Dragon)

subject: Kary
text: Kary is encountered in the southwestern room on the 5th floor, having 600 HP and casting Fir2, Dark, and Hold.

evidence.quote:
Southwestern room:  Kary...BOSS:  KARY  
HP: 600
Magic:  Fir2, Dark, Hold

subject: Kary
text: Casting Inv2 blunts Kary's physical attacks, Afir counteracts her Fir2 spell, and Fast aids attacking her strong armor.

evidence.quote: So you should cast Inv2 to help lessen Kary's blows, and Afir to counteract her Fir2 spell.  Fast should be employed on the fighting people because Kary's armor is very strong.

subject: Fire Crystal
text: Touching the Altar after defeating Kary restores glow to the second Orb.

evidence.quote: When she's defeated, move forward and touch the Altar to restore the glow to the second Orb.

subject: Sleeping citizen
text: The sleeping resident in Crescent Lake wakes up to reveal that the Floater is in the Ice Cave to the north.

evidence.quote: the fellow who was sleeping will tell you that the Floater is in the Ice Cave to the north.

subject: Overworld River
text: Weigh anchor in the river mouth north of the port and paddle the Canoe north, east, west, west to reach the Ice Cave.

evidence.quote: You have to weigh anchor in the mouth and use the Canoe to go inland.  Then follow these directions to get to the Ice Cave:  north, east, west, west.  There'll be a path of grassland and then the opening to the Cave.

subject: 1st floor stairs
text: The 1st floor path goes east and back west to reach the stairs down to the 2nd floor.

evidence.quote: 1st floor - The path takes you east and then comes back west and leads to the stairs down to the 2nd floor.

subject: 2nd floor stairs
text: From the northeast corner of the 2nd floor, head to the southwest corner to reach the stairs down to the 3rd floor.

evidence.quote: 2nd floor - You start in the northeast corner of the floor.  The stairs down to the 3rd floor are in the southwest corner.

subject: 3rd floor stairs
text: Stairs to 2nd floor B are immediately accessible upon arriving on the 3rd floor.

evidence.quote: 3rd floor - The stairs to 2nd floor B are right there.

subject: 2nd floor B pitfall
text: Falling through the hole to the right of the inaccessible chest on 2nd floor B drops the party to 3rd floor B.

evidence.quote: Fall through the one just right of the inaccessible chest.  You'll fall to 3rd floor B.

subject: 3rd floor B western treasure room
text: Going west from the undead room on 3rd floor B leads to a treasure room with a Silver Gauntlet and Ice Armor.

evidence.quote: Going west from this room leads to a treasure room with a Silver Gauntlet and Ice Armor.

subject: 3rd floor B southern treasure room
text: Heading all the way south and then west on 3rd floor B leads to a treasure room containing 40780 gold.

evidence.quote: Head all the way south and then go west to find a treasure room with 40780 gold!

subject: 3rd floor B stairs
text: Heading east on 3rd floor B leads to stairs leading back up to the 1st floor.

evidence.quote: Then head east to find the stairs back up to the first floor.

subject: 1st floor first room
text: Entering the room adjacent to the stairs on the 1st floor reveals a chest containing a Heal Potion.

evidence.quote: Enter the door right next to you to find a room with a chest containing a Heal Potion.

subject: 1st floor southern room
text: The door south on the 1st floor leads to a chest containing 10000 gold.

evidence.quote: Exit and enter the door south of you to find a chest with 10000 gold.

subject: 1st floor eastern room
text: The eastern room on the 1st floor contains a Tent, Ice Shield, and 9500 gold.

evidence.quote: Go east to find a room with a Tent, Ice Shield, and 9500 gold.

subject: 1st floor hole
text: Falling through the hole in the eastern room on the 1st floor drops the party directly beside the isolated chest on 2nd floor B.

evidence.quote: There's also a hole here.  Fall through it and you'll end up back on 2nd floor B between the holes, able to reach the chest.

subject: 2nd floor B chest
text: Guarded by an Eye, the isolated chest on 2nd floor B contains the Floater.

evidence.quote: You'll have to fight an Eye before you can get the chest.  In the chest is...the Floater!

subject: Floater
text: Using the Floater from the Item screen in the middle of the Ryukhan Desert raises the Airship.

evidence.quote: Why, he must mean the Ryukhan Desert, south of Crescent Lake.  So go there, walk into the middle of the desert, say "Abracadabra" (no, just kidding), and use the Floater on your Item screen.  Ta-daah!  The Airship rises!

subject: Airship
text: The Airship can only land on grass or plains terrain.

evidence.quote: There's just one catch to using the Airship, and that is it can only land on grass or plains.

subject: Proring
text: Prorings cost 20000 gold each in Gaia and protect characters against all instant death spells.

evidence.quote:
What you do is, after
you get the airship, you go to the town of Gaia and buy Prorings for your
characters. These protect against ALL instant death spells.(beware though,
they cost 20,000 each.

subject: Eye
text: Defeating the Eye in the Ice Cave, who has 162 HP, awards 3225 exp and 3225 g.

evidence.quote:
He has 
only 162 HP, so one or two slashes from your fighter should take care of him by 
now, and killing him will net you 3225 exp and 3225 g.

subject: Bahamut
text: Bahamut asks for proof of courage from the Castle of Ordeal to grant honor due true warriors.

evidence.quote:
One of the caves is a long hallway which leads 
to the King of Dragons, Bahamut.  He tells you that if you can return to him 
with proof of your courage, he will grant you the honor due true warriors.  
Another dragon tells you that the test of courage takes place in the Castle of 
Ordeal to the northeast, where proof of courage can be found.

subject: Airship landing
text: To reach the Castle of Ordeal, land the Airship in a grass field far to the east and hike across desert, forest, and swamp.

evidence.quote:
Far to the east, there's a grass field.  You have to land there and 
then trudge through desert, forest, and swamp to reach the Castle.

subject: Royal throne
text: Carrying the Crown and stepping on the royal throne in the northwest corner of the 1st floor transports the party to the 2nd floor.

evidence.quote:
1st floor - The sage in the center tells you that you need the Crown to test 
your courage.  Well, you have that.  He says to take it to the royal throne, and 
bring back proof of your courage.  In the northwest corner is the royal throne.  
When you step on it, you get transported to the 2nd floor.

subject: Teleport poles
text: On the 2nd floor, the pole teleport sequence is: pole 1, pole 2, bottom pole 3, pole 4, bottom pole 5, pole 6, right pole 7 for Zeus Gauntlet, then bottom-most pole 8 to the stairs.

evidence.quote:
Exit the room 
you're in and touch the pole (1).  Touch the next pole (2).  Then choose the 
bottom pole (3).  Touch the next pole (4).  Choose the bottom pole (5).  Walk 
down the hall and touch the next pole (6).  Choose the right pole (7).  Walk 
right and enter the room to find a chest with the Zeus Gauntlet.  Then touch the 
bottom-most pole (8) to enter the room with the stairs.

subject: 3rd floor northeast room
text: The northeast room on the 3rd floor contains a Heal Staff.

evidence.quote: Northeast room:  Heal Staff

subject: 3rd floor northwest room
text: The northwest room on the 3rd floor contains Gold Bracelet, Ice Sword, and Iron Gauntlet.

evidence.quote: Northwest room:  Gold Bracelet, Ice Sword, Iron Gauntlet

subject: 3rd floor southwest room
text: The southwest room on the 3rd floor contains a House and 8795 gold.

evidence.quote: Southwest room:  House, 8795 gold

subject: 3rd floor center room
text: The center room on the 3rd floor contains the Tail, which serves as the proof of courage.

evidence.quote:
Center room:  Tail

The Tail is the proof of your courage.

subject: Bahamut
text: Returning the Tail to Bahamut upgrades all party members to a higher class.

evidence.quote:
Go back to Bahamut.  He rewards your courage by changing all of you to a higher 
class.

subject: Lefein townspeople
text: Townspeople in Lefein speak Lefeinish, an ancient language.

evidence.quote:
However, if you try to go to Lefein 
right now, you won't get anything at all out of it because all of the 
townspeople speak Lefeinish, an ancient language.
